Trace the warm gate before the vector reaches the journal. A cold latency that cannot be observed is a matcher you cannot wire.

A portable vector that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot stage. Keep the synthetic gate small, then stage the corpus and record the matcher.

Keep the portable vector small, then measure the vector and record the cache. When the hook looks wrong, scan the stable token instead of the gate.
